announced on Monday that it won multiple contracts worth $100M+ to develop space intelligence and cyber capabilities for joint military operations.
The work will support RF signal collection, intelligence gathering, electronic warfare, and offensive cyber operations.
The contracts will leverage the company's KnownSpace network of 190+ RF sensors across 20+ locations, along with its software and analytics capabilities.
On the market side, the KTOS stock traded about ~1.58% higher at ~$43.75 in pre-market trading following the announcement.
